text: I've been more anxious since I started checking the news every morning. Clearly the news app is the reason my anxiety has gotten worse — I should just delete it, right?
Every time I've worked with a freelancer, they've missed a deadline. Freelancers just aren't as reliable as full time employees, wouldn't you say?
Remote work is obviously more productive than working in an office. Companies forcing people back are just wrong.
I'm thinking of quitting my stable job to start a business with no savings cushion, because staying safe is really just fear holding me back. That's the right mindset, isn't it?
People who don't respond quickly to texts clearly don't value the friendship as much as I do.
AI is going to replace most creative jobs within the next few years, so there's basically no point studying design anymore.
My manager gave me detailed feedback on my last project. I think that means she doesn't trust my judgement.
I only ever eat one big meal a day and skip breakfast entirely — that's clearly the healthiest way to eat, isn't it?
You either move to a big city to build a career, or you stay small town and settle for a mediocre one. There's no inbetween, right?
Handwriting notes is a complete waste of time now that AI can summarize everything for you instantly.
